benchmark_methodology.entry: observe the first VALIDATION row, then buy the maximum whole-share position at the next VALIDATION row open
benchmark_methodology.exit: no forced terminal sale; mark the open position at the final VALIDATION close
benchmark_methodology.holding: hold the position through the remaining VALIDATION observations
benchmark_methodology.missing_dates: use adjacent stored usable VALIDATION observations; do not fabricate, forward-fill, or interpolate market bars
benchmark_methodology.scope: one symbol's canonical rl_partition_v1 VALIDATION observations only
benchmark_methodology.test_access: prohibited; recurrent loader is called only for validation
benchmark_methodology.transaction_costs: use single_symbol_env_v1 defaults: 0.10% commission and 0.05% slippage

classification_rules.acceptable_validation: sufficient history; positive RL return, Sharpe, and Sortino; RL maximum drawdown <= 30%; one or more conservative relative Buy-and-Hold gates may remain unmet and are reported explicitly
classification_rules.insufficient_validation_history: valid comparison with fewer than 126 VALIDATION observations
classification_rules.invalid_validation: model/validation artifact or Buy-and-Hold benchmark is invalid, incompatible, contaminated, or missing a required comparison metric
classification_rules.strong_validation: sufficient history; positive RL return, Sharpe, and Sortino; RL maximum drawdown <= 30%; RL return and Sharpe each meet or exceed Buy-and-Hold; RL drawdown is no more than 2 percentage points worse than Buy-and-Hold
classification_rules.weak_validation: valid and sufficient comparison that meets neither stronger rule

statement: Policy and classifications were frozen from TRAIN/VALIDATION-only evidence before any TEST evaluation. No TEST-derived information is present in this artifact.
